# Endpoints

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mjs from packages/sdk/src/endpoints.ts (PEPU_HOSTED, PEPU_ENV) and the contract registry. Do not edit by hand; run `node scripts/gen-docs.mjs`. -->

Every endpoint the dev kit talks to, in one table: the public RPC and explorer, and the bundler and paymaster. Docs elsewhere write `PEPU_BUNDLER_URL` and `PEPU_PAYMASTER_URL` as placeholders and point here for what they mean. This page is generated from the SDK, so it cannot disagree with `resolvePepuEndpoints()`.

The SDK uses the hosted bundler and paymaster service by default (`PEPU_HOSTED`); the environment variables below override them. Bundler `https://bundler.pepeunchained.com`, paymaster service `https://paymaster.pepeunchained.com`. The ERC-7677 paymaster URL always embeds a token (`https://paymaster.pepeunchained.com/v2/paymaster/<token>`), so it is never a default: set `PEPU_PAYMASTER_URL` to it.

## Prerequisites

- Nothing for the RPC and explorer. Sponsored transactions also need a bundler and a paymaster, see [Infrastructure Map](../infra/overview.md).

## Endpoint table

| Service | Value | Environment variable | Local development default |
|---|---|---|---|
| RPC (chain `97741`) | `https://rpc-pepu-v2-mainnet-0.t.conduit.xyz` | `PEPU_RPC_URL` (browser: `NEXT_PUBLIC_PEPU_RPC_URL`) | none, use the public RPC |
| Explorer (PepuScan) | `https://pepuscan.com` | none | none |
| Explorer API (Blockscout) | `https://pepuscan.com/api` | none | none |
| Bundler (ERC-4337, EntryPoint v0.7) | `https://bundler.pepeunchained.com` | `PEPU_BUNDLER_URL` (browser: `NEXT_PUBLIC_PEPU_BUNDLER_URL`) | `http://localhost:4337` |
| Paymaster service (REST API, health, free-tier state) | `https://paymaster.pepeunchained.com` | base of `PEPU_PAYMASTER_URL` | `http://localhost:8788` |
| Paymaster ERC-7677 URL | `https://paymaster.pepeunchained.com/v2/paymaster/<token>` | `PEPU_PAYMASTER_URL` (browser: `NEXT_PUBLIC_PEPU_PAYMASTER_URL`) | `http://localhost:8788/v2/paymaster/<your-token>` |

The ERC-7677 paymaster URL carries a credential in its path (`/v2/paymaster/<token>`). A project **client token** (`ppt_`) is publishable but only works from the project's allowed origins: with none set, or from another origin, the service refuses it with `project_origin_not_allowed`. A project **server key** (`ppk_`) is a secret: keep it on the server and never put it in a `NEXT_PUBLIC_` variable. The **free tier** (100 PEPU/day and 50 PEPU/hour per user, TapScore as the only target for now) needs a verified Privy access token from PEPU's own Privy app sent as `context.privyAccessToken` in the ERC-7677 request; it is not available to apps on their own Privy app. See [Credential Matrix](../infra/paymaster/auth.md).

## How the SDK resolves them

`resolvePepuEndpoints()` picks each value in this order: an explicit option, then the environment (the server variable, then the `NEXT_PUBLIC_` variable), then the hosted default in `PEPU_HOSTED`. A malformed URL throws `CONFIG_BAD_URL` naming the variable, never its value. It returns `bundlerUrl`, `paymasterUrl` (the complete ERC-7677 URL, `null` unless you configured one, because it needs a token) and `paymasterBaseUrl` (the service base: the hosted base unless `PEPU_PAYMASTER_URL` points elsewhere, in which case the `/v2/paymaster/<token>` tail is stripped). `createPaymasterApi`, the probes, `checkSponsorship` and `pepu doctor` default to the base; `createPepuPaymasterClient` needs the complete URL or a `paymasterToken`. `hostedErc7677Url(token)` builds `<hosted base>/v2/paymaster/<token>` and `hostedFreeTierUrl()` the public free-tier state route. `isHostedSponsorshipLive()` is `true` only when the hosted bundler and paymaster base are both set.

| Value | Explicit option | Server variable | Browser variable | Hosted default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| RPC | `rpcUrl` | `PEPU_RPC_URL` | `NEXT_PUBLIC_PEPU_RPC_URL` | `https://rpc-pepu-v2-mainnet-0.t.conduit.xyz` |
| Bundler | `bundlerUrl` | `PEPU_BUNDLER_URL` | `NEXT_PUBLIC_PEPU_BUNDLER_URL` | `https://bundler.pepeunchained.com` |
| Paymaster ERC-7677 URL | `paymasterUrl` | `PEPU_PAYMASTER_URL` | `NEXT_PUBLIC_PEPU_PAYMASTER_URL` | none (needs your token) |
| Paymaster service base | `baseUrl` (`createPaymasterApi`) | base of `PEPU_PAYMASTER_URL` | base of `NEXT_PUBLIC_PEPU_PAYMASTER_URL` | `https://paymaster.pepeunchained.com` |

## Hosted-URL swap (maintainers)

The only place the hosted URLs are set is `PEPU_HOSTED` in `packages/sdk/src/endpoints.ts`. To change them: edit it, rebuild the SDK, run `node scripts/gen-docs.mjs`, run `pnpm --filter @pepu-chain/mcp snapshots`, then release the SDK and the MCP server together. See `RELEASING.md`.

## What to expect

- `pepu_health_check` and `pepu_sponsorship_status` report "not configured" for the bundler and paymaster until you set the variables or the hosted URLs exist.
- `node scripts/check-docs-parity.mjs` verifies the addresses and counts on the docs pages against the SDK registry.

## Common failures

| Symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `CONFIG_BAD_URL` | A URL variable is not a valid http(s) URL | Fix the variable the message names |
| `CONFIG_MISSING_ENV` for the paymaster | No complete ERC-7677 URL: it always embeds a token, so there is no tokenless default | Set `PEPU_PAYMASTER_URL` to `https://paymaster.pepeunchained.com/v2/paymaster/<token>`, or pass `paymasterToken` |
| Browser calls to the bundler fail with CORS errors | The bundler does not allow your origin | See [Operating the Bundler](../infra/bundler/operating.md) |
